A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 50-page versions of the same Creativity Index and DJ Search study. The main text, equations, algorithms, figures, Appendices A-C and supplementary examples support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 3 and Figures 3-4 report original human-versus-LLM creativity measurements, RLHF comparisons, ablations and machine-text detection results. The appendices provide experimental details and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical measurements, comparisons and detection results in Section 3 and Figures 3-4, together with the appendix examples.

M1.justification: The Creativity Index computation and DJ Search procedure are unchanged, including two-pointer search, Infini-gram matching, Word Mover's Distance, BM25 retrieval and reference-corpus deduplication (Section 2; Appendix A).

E1.justification: Both versions use the same novel, poetry, speech, news and theorem-proof tasks, human-author groups, RedPajama corpus and model-generated reference corpora (Section 3; Appendix B).

E2.justification: The evaluated language-model sets are unchanged. Figure 3n retains the same detection comparators: DetectGPT, RoBERTa-base, RoBERTa-large and Ghostbuster.

E3.justification: The sampling procedures, prompts, model configurations, AUROC evaluation and search parameters remain unchanged. Appendix B retains top-p sampling with p = 0.9 and the same 288-token generation and 2048-token reference-continuation limits.

E4.justification: The same analyses examine matching criteria, RLHF, reference-document concentration, human-author groups, prompts, decoding and model size. Figures 3-4 and the qualitative examples in Figures 5-30 contain no added or removed analyses.

E5.justification: The Mann-Whitney U tests, reported p-values, sample-size annotations and graphical distribution summaries are unchanged. No run-count, seed or uncertainty-reporting information is added.

E6.justification: The numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. Section 3 retains the reported human creativity advantages of 52.2% for novels, 31.1% for poetry and 115.3% for speeches. The result graphics and supplementary examples also match.

T1.justification: The L-uniqueness and Creativity Index definitions, search-complexity reasoning, Word Mover's Distance derivations and deduplication formulas remain unchanged (Section 2; Appendix A). Footnote renumbering does not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about linguistic creativity, reduced creativity after alignment, and zero-shot machine-text detection. The resource footnote does not revise these scientific claims.

C2.justification: Section 4 retains the same mechanism interpretations and limitations concerning reference-corpus coverage, private training data, overlap versus memorization, and the focus on high-quality human writing. Text crossing different page boundaries is unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds footnote 1 on page 1 stating that code and data are available through the GXimingLu/creativity_index GitHub repository; v1 lacks this access information. Implementation details and experimental settings in Appendices A-B are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in Section 5, Appendix C and the bibliography are unchanged. Bibliography entries shift across pages without additions or removals.

P1.justification: Yejin Choi's listed affiliation changes from NVIDIA to the University of Washington. v2 also adds the resource footnote and renumbers subsequent footnotes; the scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The revised affiliation block and added first-page footnote produce limited layout changes and text reflow, including the conclusion continuing onto page 11. Figures 1-30 retain their content, captions and arrangement.

improvement.justification: The new code-and-data repository pointer modestly improves reproducibility documentation by giving readers explicit resource-access information absent from v1. Scientific evidence and limitations remain unchanged, and the layout edits have little effect on quality. The supplied PDFs do not establish the repository's completeness or usability.
